title: One Plus Capital
description:
Overview

Country: Cyprus | Website: onepluscapital.net | Revenue: $7 Million | Industry: Finance | Employees: 11-50 | Properties: 117 GB (285,919 Files, 32,404 Folders)
Detailed Analysis

One Plus Capital offers boutique investment and financial services to high net worth individuals and corporate clients. They focus on building long-term relationships and providing tailor-made solutions with diversified portfolios and proper asset allocation. Their services include portfolio management, investment advisory, brokerage, corporate finance, and custody safekeeping, all delivered by highly qualified professionals. By adhering to traditional values such as confidentiality and trust, One Plus Capital aims to secure the future of their clients through personalized and transparent financial relationships
